CHILD LABOUR
Q1 (a) Wekesa was looking after the animals because: (direct question)
 - His aunt told him to do so
 - He feared punishment from the aunt
 (b) Wekesa missed: (prediction question)
 - Lessons taught on that day at school
 - His friends at school
 - Play at school
 - Food served at school
 (c) The teacher will tell Wekesa’s aunt: (prediction question)
 - To allow Wekesa to go to school
 - Not to tell Wekesa to look after the animals during school day
 - Not to punish Wekesa for going to school
 SAFETY AT HOME
Q2 (a) If the children do not listen to their mother’s advice: (prediction question)
 - they could get burnt
 - they could get into trouble
 - they could be hurt
 - they could be punished
 (b) Dangerous means: (vocabularyquestion)
 - harmful
ENGLISH SECTION A MS GRADE 4 2
THE DOVE AND THE CAT
Q3 (a) The cat and the dove stopped living together because; (direct question)
 - The dove got disappointed and walked away when the cat did not bring food
 for her and her chicks.
 - The cat is selfish/a bad friend
 (b) The cat is: (inference question)
 - A bad friend
 - A selfish/mean friend
 - A greedy friend
 (c) Unwell means: (vocabulary question)
 - sick
A WEDDING DAY
Q4 (a) People sing and dance in wedding because:-(inference question)
 - They are happy or excited or joyful
 - They are celebrating
 - They are praising the bride and the bridegroom
 (b) Amani did not want the wedding to end because: (prediction question)
 - the day was enjoyable
 - she was happy
 - she liked the wedding
 - she enjoyed dancing and singing.
 (c) A word that means the same as meal: (vocabulary question)
 - food
 - dish
ENGLISH SECTION A MS GRADE 4 3 TURN OVER
LEADERSHIP
Q5 (a) A leader is a person who can: (inference question)
 - Listen
 - Encourage
 - Accept others
 - Defend others
 - Educate
 - Respect
 - Serve others
 (b) The two duties that begin with the same letters are: (direct question)
 - Encourage
 - Educate
 (c) The word that means the same as to teach is (vocabulary question)
 - Educate
COMPUTER ROOM RULES
Q6 (a) The things that are not allowed in the computer room are (direct question)
 - food
 (b) We should handle the computers carefully (inference question)
 - So that it does not get spoilt/damaged.
 - to keep it free from dirt or dust.
 - to make it last longer.
